subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should fresh Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan onboarding both select `mimo-v2.5`, rather than the current source defaults of `mimo-v2-flash` and `mimo-v2.5-pro`?
rationale: The catalog addition repairs a concrete availability gap, but choosing the initial model also selects the default capability and price profile for new provider users; that policy choice is not resolved by tests alone.

options.title: Confirm V2.5 for both defaults
options.body: Rebase the PR and keep both new-install defaults on `mimo-v2.5`, matching the current Xiaomi documentation and the contributor's replacement rationale.

options.title: Land catalog-only availability
options.body: Keep the V2.5 catalog and documentation corrections but preserve one or both current source defaults until Xiaomi default policy is separately confirmed.

recommendation.title: Confirm V2.5 for both defaults
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and keep both new-install defaults on `mimo-v2.5`, matching the current Xiaomi documentation and the contributor's replacement rationale.
